DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Ab: Take a rest and get sucked into the ancient pages of the Abyssal Grimoire. Be cautious when reciting any of these unorthodox incantations, you never know what might occur.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Bo: If you're seeking a new adventure, spin the bottle to decide your next path. Something unexpected might be waiting in the direction it points.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Co: A seasoned adventurer never moves without a plan. Whenever you have a moment, unfold your map, find your next path, and prepare for a safe journey.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Cu: Unwind and enjoy the soothing pleasure of a perfect cup of coffee.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Da: This honeycomb delicacy tempts with both taste and challenge. Snap it right, and you’ll enjoy every bite. Snap it wrong... well, better luck next time.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_El: Lounging effortlessly in a graceful pose, indulging in a well-deserved break from your adventures.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Et: Place your hands upon your chest and close your eyes. As your strength fades, you descend into a slumber akin to death itself.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Fr: Sit down and feast like a king! Nothing is more satisfying than fresh meat after an exhilarating battle.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Ha: Take a seat, drink deeply, and savor the fruits of your labor with the Tavern Master's own special brew, a strong, warming ale.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Id: Sitting still anywhere feels unbearable, so pass the time by absentmindedly flicking a coin over and over.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Le: Sit comfortably and begin your meditation. As you delve deep into your inner self, you will soon find your body lifting into the air.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Pr: Do not be flustered by whatever hardship stands before you. In such moments, take a step back, calm your mind, bring your hands together, and say a prayer. Oooooom.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Ro: There are many ways to pass the time in the darkness, but few are as sweet as toasting a marshmallow... just don’t let it burn.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Ru: There’s something satisfying about surveying and organizing your spoils; each treasure has its place, and every piece tells a story.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Sh: You never know when or where you might face an enemy, so sharpen your blade whenever you find a moment to spare. Keep it keen.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Sk: Roast a savory meal while you replenish your strength.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Sl: Delve into the depths of comfort, nestled up in the warmth of a sleeping bag.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Sq: Stay alert while taking a brief rest. Even if a sudden attack or a monster appears, you can respond quickly.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Te: Relax in true buccaneer fashion, seated with a spyglass, ever on the lookout for treasures, threats, and new horizons.
DC.Text_DesignData_ActionSkin_FlavorText_Wh: As you rest, you carve a wooden figure, each cut filled with memories of home and the hope of gifting it to a loved one—provided you make it out alive...

Enduring through raw strength and vitality, the Crocodilian values survival above all. When their river home began to rot, they turned to the sea and became deep-sea predators.
Born of shadows and secrets, their origins remain unknown. Some believe they are a distinct people, while others think they were once normal elves influenced by sinister powers.
Renowned for their mastery of magic, the Dark Elves are cloaked in mystery and darkness, once like their kin but forever altered by sinister forces.

An Ifrit who dreamed of becoming human. Having shaved off his flaming beard, he believes no one will recognize who he really is. If it weren't for his blazing red hair and glowing eyes, the disguise might actually have worked.

Born in the depths of the Inferno, this race worships strength above all else, considering it only natural to challenge the powerful at any time. The victor basks in the glory bestowed upon them, while the defeated temper themselves in their fury, ever seeking the next opportunity to rise again.

Dwarves are the race that loves metal more than any other, and none surpass them as blacksmiths. Their obsession with metal is etched into their blood, and the hammer is as natural to them as speech. Though stubborn and strict at the forge, they are hearty, cheerful, and love drink. Survive a night of drinking with a dwarf, and you may earn their lasting favor.

Dwarves are the race that loves metal more than any other, and none surpass them as blacksmiths. Their obsession with metal is etched into their blood, and the hammer is as natural to them as speech. Though stubborn and strict at the forge, they are hearty, cheerful, and love drink. Survive a night of drinking with a dwarf, and you may earn their lasting favor.
An Elven warrior from the mystical, forbidden forest lands.
Embrace the Elven ways, where grace and agility stand as a testament to their ancient and mystical heritage.

The Elite Crocodilian embodies relentless instinct and destructive might. To claim dominion over the seas, they clash unflinchingly with other races, never hesitating to employ cruel means for victory.
Bones soaked in the blood of countless enemies, the walking embodiment of death.
Elite Tidewalkers are hunters hardened through countless battles. They are survivors of the Maelstrom’s trials, granted the honor of guarding their tribe’s shaman.
The Emberflame Skeleton is an undead creature reborn from molten depths. Crimson fire pulses through the cracks in its blackened bones, and its body radiates intense heat.

Carving tales of conquest through varied terrains, these Felids' every stride is a decisive maneuver. Known for their tactical brilliance, they outwit foes with the ferocity of chessmasters, always two moves ahead.

With each step, she weaves a tale of allure and mystery, her tabby stripes a canvas of the earth's deep secrets, celebrated for her wit that dazzles and disorients like a playful dance in twilight shadows.

Celebrated for their wit and charm, yet are also known for their mischievous and capricious nature. Their firm belief in their own infallibility makes engaging them in debate like wrestling with a shadow: you never really get a grip, and it’s probably not going to end well for you.

Her coat, as white as the snow-capped peaks she calls home, is adorned with spots like the darkness between stars. Her eyes gleam like twin moons, and those who cross her path rarely live to tell the tale.

A dwarf consumed by the fiery calamity. His blazing crimson eyes no longer hold any trace of reason, and searing heat radiates from his scorched skin. Having lost all sense of self, he endlessly digs into the earth.
A dwarf consumed by the fiery calamity. The hands that once crafted magnificent works now do nothing but dig through the earth. She no longer remembers who she was, nor why she ever raised a hammer.
The chill of the grave personified, within these frozen bones, this skeletal warrior bears the essence of an eternal winter.
From the icy depths of death, this undead monstrosity trudges forth, spreading the cold touch of doom.
Bones gilded in the gold of a long-lost aristocracy, this royalty-turned-offering is sure to satisfy even the most begrudging deity.

Ifrits are beings born of fire. With flames for hair, they possess an inherently destructive nature. This disposition extends even to their own kind, so they do not form groups and instead live independently.

A being that appears on winter nights to judge wrongdoing. Its fearsome guise makes it hard to approach, yet there is no need for fear if you bear no sin. Should you receive a Krampus coin from it, you may hope for Saint Nicholas’s blessing in the coming year.
Rarely born with pale scales. These hunters are said to possess a mystical aura from birth. Within their tribe they are regarded as beings destined for a special fate.
Sworn keepers of marshland secrets, these scaly beings are equally renowned for their intellectual pursuits and their skill in battle.
The Emberflame Lizardmen are heretics blessed by fire. They harbor an unquenchable heat within, and as their fighting spirit ignites, a crimson aura shines vividly through the cracks in their scales.
Guardians of the swamp's hidden wisdom, as skilled in scholarly arts as they are in the lethal dance of combat.
Natural hunters wise in the ways of the jungle with a native skill for survival. Their thick scales provide basic innate protection.
With fangs bared and claws poised, this feral beast is said to have been spawned from a curse bestowed by one of the four major demon lords.
This race of Lycan is said to have received their brown fur as a gift from an ancient forest demigod to help his chosen guardians blend into the woods more seamlessly.

Summoned by a powerful entity to torment a king in his dreams. However, their malevolent influence grew too strong, transcending the boundary between nightmares and reality, ultimately claiming the king's life.
Cursed for hunting the Midnight Stag, this lycan’s inner savagery has been amplified, compelling it to feel an overwhelming urge to destroy all it sees, whether friend or foe.

With fur as luminescent as moonlit clouds, these creatures are thought to bear the blessing of the lunar goddess herself. Their existence signifies that of a higher purpose, hopefully one that doesn't end in bloodshed.

Garbed in ancient wrappings, the mummified form carries the whispers of a thousand years with each step. It is both a keeper of old secrets and a herald of primordial curses whispered in the shadows of ages past.
An imp completely consumed by the power of death. The vile aura that spreads from this demon drives its kin into madness, urging them to charge into battle without fear of death.
The Nightmare Crocodilian bears the majesty of a ruthless predator. The deep scar across its eye is both the proof of survival through countless battles and the unbroken emblem of victory.
This skeleton wanders the frozen depths of Frost Mountain, its cold bones creaking with every step.
This cold corpse wanders eternally in search of new death, leaving behind a foul stench wherever it passes.
The nightmare mummy, risen once more after turning its back on death, prowls in search of living flesh. Yet it is forever bound to the tomb from which it awakened.
This creature has crawled up from the dark, sunless depths of the abyss. The Nightmare Seawalker’s lifeless violet eyes emit a chilling gleam when it locks onto its prey.
Summoned from the depths of the darkest dreams, the Nightmare Skeleton strides forth as a living incarnation of terror, bridging the gap between the nightmarish and our reality.
Risen from the depths of the Inferno, the Nightmare Skeleton Crossbowman is relentless with its aim, each bolt striking with deadly precision.

Nightmare Tidewalkers are the bravest warriors who stand at the forefront of battle. Having long borne the duty of protecting their tribe’s survival, they are respected and followed even by the shamans.
Hailing from the rugged Orc tribes from afar, where survival of the fittest is the only law.

The Emberflame Orc is a being of fierce combat instinct, further fueled by the power of fire. As battle grows more intense, the heat within reaches a boiling point, and a vivid crimson glow seeps through the cracks of their hardened black skin.

Orcs are a race driven by fierce combat instincts. They harden themselves through constant rivalry and may at any time challenge the strong to claim a higher place. Yet every such path demands a price paid in blood.
Molded by the harsh conditions of the Orcs' homeland, they embody resilience and pure strength.
This mummy writhes ceaselessly in an attempt to escape its smoldering agony. Yet the embers clinging to the wrappings around its body never fade.
This corpse, long submerged in the sea, leaks foul water with every step, leaving behind a trail of sticky footprints.
A walking pile of bones, terrifying to behold.

Once a valiant knight, the Skeleton Champion earned his medal through unmatched prowess and unwavering loyalty to the now, Ghost King. In life, he fought bravely before his sovereign; in death, he remains a spectral warrior, eternally bound to the echoes of his king’s command.
This rag-draped skeletal mage may appear frail, but wields powerful magic. At times, its destructive force is so great that even the caster can’t withstand it.

A beguiling demon that stirs the desires of mortals and leads them to corruption. The honeyed smile and graceful gesture are nothing but a snare for the unwary. Behind that beautiful visage lurks the soul of a predator, ever hungering for the life essence of its prey.

Tidewalkers are a primitive marine race that has long dwelled in the waters surrounding the Blue Maelstrom. Enduring the fiercest currents without fear, they rely on their innate instincts to tenaciously track and bring down their prey.

A rare Tidewalker found in the Blue Maelstrom. These creatures reject the laws of the tribe and live apart from the influence of the shamans. Over time, their coloration gradually fades, making them increasingly difficult to spot beneath the water.

A dark elf that has reached the end of its life, yet wanders the mortal realm unable to find eternal rest. The sinister power that once corrupted their kind now stands in the way of their final peace.
Devoid of life yet unyielding, it shuffles beneath a shroud of rot. The stench of decay lingers, brittle bones exposed to the ravages of time.

DC.Text_DesignData_Dungeon_DungeonType_Desc: Test your adventuring skills in a dangerous forgotten castle filled with evil monsters.
The Forgotten Castle : Adventure Desc

This dungeon is not for the faint of heart. Pay a steep fee simply to enter this unforgiving dungeon. The monsters are unrelenting and the exit portals are few. If you make it out alive your fame will be known across the lands!
Test your adventuring skills in a dangerous forgotten castle filled with evil monsters.
A newly discovered cave system found near the tavern. What dangers lurk below?
The Goblin Caves : Adventure Desc

This dungeon is for the elite adventurer. Pay a steep fee simply to enter this unforgiving network of caves. The goblins do not take kindly to uninvited guests. If you make it out alive, your name will be written in the annals of history!
A newly discovered cave system found near the tavern. What dangers lurk below?
A vast network of subzero caves and mines, home to icy terrors.
The Frost Mountain : Adventure Desc
An imposing snowy peak formed around an ancient crater known as a portal to the unknown abyss. The bitter and relentless cold proves challenging even to the hardiest adventurers.
A vast network of subzero caves and mines, home to icy terrors.
Random Dungeons Desc
The High-Roller Dungeons are the ultimate challenge for only the strongest adventurers. You and your party will be placed into a Random dungeon locale.
Start out in low quality gear in a competitive quest to make it out of a random dungeon with the best loot and gear.

Hidden within a shadowy forest, the ruins of a massive castle hold deep mysteries. Fantastic creatures and terrifying monsters await unlucky adventurers looking for untold treasures. If you make it out alive your renown will be endless!
The remains of an impenetrable fortress besieged by a disturbing aura.
Explore the depths of the oceans and search for pirate’s gold but be sure to get out before the seas get too rough.
The Blue Maelstrom : Adventure Desc
The terrors of the seas and a roaring tempest may be your undoing.
Explore the depths of the oceans and search for pirate’s gold but be sure to get out before the seas get too rough.
DC.Text_DesignData_Dungeon_Dungeon_IceAbyss: The Frost Mountain - Ice Abyss (High-Roller Adventure)
The Frost Mountain - Ice Abyss (Squire Royale)
DC.Text_DesignData_Dungeon_Dungeon_IceCaver: The Frost Mountain - Ice Cavern (High-Roller Adventure)
The Frost Mountain - Ice Cavern (Squire Royale)
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_B: Few can conjure this timeless melody, each note hanging in the air, daring adventurers to chase the unknown.

The banner that bears the might of the Black Despair. This ruthless crew does not hide their brutality. They flaunt it, feeding on the fear of others. In their wake remain only blazing fires, shattered wreckage, and this banner.
Show that you have heard enough talking, it might be time to start fighting.
Send a tender kiss sailing through the air, a whimsical token of affection for someone special.
Inspect the bounty poster and carefully examine your next prey. Paying close attention to the price set upon their head is of utmost importance.
A humble and respectful posture, honoring those before you.
A humble and respectful posture, honoring those before you.
Take a swig of liquor and blow it toward the torch. You will unleash a fiery breath worthy of a dragon.
Taunt your enemies in a challenging signal, beckoning your foe to test their might against yours.
Splash out the water from a bucket filled to the brim. Along with the refreshing sound, your worries might wash away too.
Sometimes, a bucket of cold water is more effective than any advice for regaining focus.
You too can become a wizard. Brace your core and unleash a powerful blast to rival a fireball. The overwhelming force will leave everyone holding their breath.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_C: The season of sweet mischief has returned. With a generous heart, toss a handful of colorful candies into the air. Everyone you meet in the dungeon, from humans to beasts and even monsters, will find themselves captivated by that delicious temptation.
Blow a seductive kiss. Whatever may lie behind that subtle smile, they will find it difficult to look away from you.
The moment you raise a frothy mug of ale, the air around you seems to soften. Set aside the suffocating tension for a while and share a refreshing moment over a cool drink with your companions.

Play a gentle carole to mark the year’s end. As its soft notes drift outward, the chill in the air eases and a warm spirit settles over those nearby. Even strangers may find themselves clapping along, sharing in the moment.
Heads or tails? Flip the coin and let fate decide your fortune.
The conch shell horn carries a gentle tone that echoes with the voice of the sea. Its sound travels clearly into the depths of the water, bringing courage and calm to those who hear it.
An elegant way to greet or bid farewell.
Silently issuing a warning, making your intentions clear.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_D: Start a precarious juggling act with savage tools. Onlookers may feel a little uneasy, but don’t worry. As long as you catch them properly, nothing will happen.
Express righteous indignation at all that has angered you. This furious stomp shall be the embodiment of your wrath.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_E: It is a banner that symbolizes the flames burning within Firedeep. As long as the red tongues of flame flicker, Firedeep will never grow cold. As proof, the place where this banner stands is slowly consumed by heat, until even the air itself grows hot.
When everything pushes you to your limits and you can’t endure it anymore, don’t hold it in. Cry out loud and your heart will calm down.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_F: Catch the falling apple with swift reflexes, then relish the pleasant surprise as you enjoy its sweet, crisp flavor.
A putrid outburst that compels all to respect the depths of your inner turmoil.
Aim your digits like dual pistols, playfully sending imaginary bullets their way.
With a sharp snap of your fingers, you bring a moment of levity to any situation.
Swing a torch in swift circles to create a great ring of fire. The crimson flames weaving through the air evoke memories of joyous festival nights.
To express congratulations, applaud enthusiastically. Sometimes, it can also be an expression of madness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_G: Set off a colorful burst of confetti to celebrate those who have overcome difficult and challenging times. Your small gesture of support can give them the courage they need for a bright and hopeful future.
A dance, born from the green feet of goblins and infused with mischievous rhythm by the Kobolds, celebrates the shared culture between the two races.
A grand exhibition of opulence that proclaims not only immense wealth, but also celestial favor.
Self-care is serious business. Groom away the remnants of conflict, preparing to face whatever’s next—ensuring you look dapper for the adventures ahead.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_H: Express affection with a heart-shaped gesture, radiating love and positive energy.
The harder the situation, the more you must hold onto your laughter. One hearty laugh is all it takes to lighten even the heaviest of steps.
A symbol of dedication displayed by true line holders who never lost their faith.
Sometimes, it's the distant things that deserve your focus. Shield your eyes and widen your gaze. You may discover a path or treasure no one else has found.
Summon the echoes of old as you lift the ancient horn to your lips, its deep and resonant call stirring the air with the power of long-forgotten legends.
It's good to be thorough. Some things, however, are better left untested.
Awaken the beast within, and let loose a howl that echoes through the lands, calling out to friends or serving as a warning to foes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_I: An expressive shrug conveying your lack of knowledge or interest.
Sometimes, actions speak louder than words. If there is someone you need to keep an eye on, look them straight in the eyes and gesture quietly.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_K: Take your anger out on the ground. It'll hurt your feet though...
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_L: Wordlessly articulate another's defeat or inadequacy.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_M: Tradition holds that all quarrels must cease beneath the mistletoe and peace be made. Raise a small sprig aloft and let its presence invite calm. If someone dear stands beside you, the moment may yet turn a touch more romantic.
Scatter gold as if all the wealth in the world belongs to you.
Your lurching stride brings a touch of the macabre to any gathering, making you the life (or unlife) of the dungeon.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_N: Openly display the sign for 'noob', signaling that someone is on a visible learning curve.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_P: Point with purpose, marking your target for all to see.
Let your drink seep into the ground, symbolizing a silent tribute to those who are no longer with us.
Having well-developed chest and front deltoids, along with well-defined trapezius muscles, at the very least provides a strong sense of confidence.
Seek solace in a moment of prayer.

It is a furious drum performance that awakens the will to fight. Each strike sends sparks flying and heightens the heat of the battlefield. When the heavy reverberation strikes the heart you are soon drawn into the madness of battle.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_R: Throw your hands up and run with joy. Like a carefree Reefling, run without a thought and before you know it, even your worries will have vanished far away.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_S: A dance shared after long voyages, when drink and music flow. Its lively steps soon draw everyone into a spirit of merriment.
Show a gesture of mild respect to others.
This salute honors the fallen and inspires the living, a silent testament to the bonds forged in battle.
Place your index finger against your mouth, signaling an unspoken request for silence.
Elegantly lift both hands up and sing a siren song
Snap your fingers to conjure a spark. Done properly, it's sure to draw everyone's attention. Done poorly, it might cost you a few fingers.

It is a dance that strikes the ground with powerful steps to show the strength of one’s legs. Dwarves enliven it with lively claps and simple repeating chants. When one dancer begins, the others soon join and it can become a celebration that lasts for hours.
If someone is bothering you, push back with everything you've got. Enough is enough!
Raise both hands to show surrender.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_T: Sometimes a little mockery strikes harder than any blade.
An enchanting dance, captivating all who witness your elegant moves.
Convey disapproval or dissatisfaction with a simple downward gesture of your thumb.
A simple way to show your approval or agreement.
If there's something to celebrate, whether it's victory, escape or survival, don't hesitate to raise your glass and mark the moment.
You cannot withstand the chill that seeps into your very bones. No matter how thick your clothing, no matter how near you sit to a warm campfire, the trembling in your body refuses to cease.
A putrescent belch that makes one ponder the true origin of Poison Clouds.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_W: Open the finely wrapped gift prepared for you. Within lies a special token to mark the passing year. That is, unless someone has quietly switched it when you weren’t looking.
Kneel in reverence and offer your devotion to a true champion of the dungeons.
DC.Text_DesignData_Emote_Emote_FlavorText_Y: Circle your finger around your temple, signaling a silent but vivid declaration of another's irrationality.

Show your allegiance to the Black Despair Crew with this exclusive bundle featuring the Black Despair Cloak and matching Black Despair Crew Nameplate.

Prepare for the perilous journey through the Firedeep. This bundle includes the Challengers of the Firedeep nameplate, the Runic Potion skin, the Runic Bandage skin, and the Runic Sash skin.
A cloak corrupted and rotted by the brimstone gas of the inferno. The sulfurous mold spreading from the shoulders looks foul, but it guards the mind against being consumed by the brimstone flames.
Don the formidable visage of the Firedeep’s legendary dwellers. This bundle includes both Ash-Beard Dwarf skin and Cinder-Braid Dwarf skin.

Are you prepared to endure flames that never fade? This bundle includes the Embervein Cloak skin and the Baldrun Flask skin. For this season, the Embervein Cloak skin is available exclusively through this bundle.
Wield smoldering weapons and dominate the battlefield. This bundle includes the Emberflame Felling Axe and Emberflame Bardiche skins.

Celebrate the festive season with cheerful carols. This exclusive bundle includes the Christmas Carole and the Mistletoe emote.
Experience the realm of the dwarves in the Firedeep. This bundle includes the Firedeep Dwarf (Male) and Firedeep Dwarf (Female) character skins, along with the Runesmith Chamber lobby skin.
Beat the winter chill with the coldest of comforts. This exclusive bundle includes the Winter Ruins Camp lobby skin, the Frost Heart soulheart skin, and the Winter Frost Cloak.
Dazzle your foes on the battlefield with ornately decorated weapons. This bundle includes the Gilded Francisca Axe and the Gilded Throwing Knife skins.
The flames of Inferno await you. This bundle includes the Demon character skin, the Necrotic Soulheart skin, and the Inferno's Breath nameplate.
Welcome the demon who rises in winters abandoned by Saint Nicholas. This exclusive bundle includes the Krampus character skin, the Wicked Gift emote, and the Wicked Potion skin.
Show your faith in Noxulon. This bundle includes a buckler, round shield, heater shield, lantern shield, and pavise, each marked with Noxulon’s symbol.

Claim runic equipment crafted by ancient dwarven forgemasters. This bundle includes the Runic Rapier, Runic Viking Sword, Runic Falchion, Runic Stiletto Dagger, Runic Short Sword, Runic War Hammer, and Runic Halberd skins.
Claim runic equipment crafted by ancient dwarven forgemasters. This bundle includes the Runic Ceremonial Staff, Runic Recurve Bow, and Runic Crystal Ball skins.
Express your individuality with sashes in a variety of colors. This bundle includes sash skins in red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, black, and navy.
Show your faith in Solaris. This bundle includes a buckler, round shield, heater shield, lantern shield, and pavise, each marked with Solaris’s symbol.
Gift your enemies a beautiful nightmare. This bundle includes the Succubus's Survival Bow and Succubus's Rapier skins.
Succumb to the allure of a captivating succubus. This bundle includes the Succubus character skin and the Charming Kiss emote.
Gift your enemies a beautiful nightmare. This bundle includes the Succubus's Longsword and Succubus's Halberd skins.
Gift your enemies a beautiful nightmare. This bundle includes the Succubus's Survival Bow and Succubus's Spear skins.
Gift your enemies a beautiful nightmare. This bundle includes the Succubus's Halberd and Succubus's Spellbook skins.
Gift your enemies a beautiful nightmare. This bundle includes the Succubus's Spellbook and Succubus's Magic Staff skins.
Show your allegiance to the Tidebound Crew with this exclusive bundle featuring the Tidebound Cloak and matching Tidebound Roses Nameplate.

We’ve prepared something to help make your winter a little warmer this year. This exclusive bundle includes the Candyflame Torch, the Winterflame Roast Campfire skin, and the Winterlight Lantern skin.
Show your faith in Zorin. This bundle includes a buckler, round shield, heater shield, lantern shield, and pavise, each marked with Zorin’s symbol.

This torch is imbued with seething flames. Cracks formed by the intense heat run along the handle, where a crimson glow flickers as if alive.
An eerie torch with no flame, instead only one brightly glowing red gemstone salvaged from the abyssal depths of hell’s blood lakes themselves.
A buckler featuring a green background and Blythar’s serpent symbol painted upon it. It includes a reinforced grip for close-quarters defense.
A heater shield bearing a green background and Blythar’s serpent symbol painted upon it. Crafted from wood reinforced with leather, it allows the wielder to more easily withstand frontal attacks.

A lantern shield marked with a green background and Blythar’s serpent symbol painted upon it. Equipped with a folding blade and an integrated lantern, it suits followers adept in deception and manipulation.
A pavise adorned with a green background and Blythar’s serpent symbol painted upon it. Its large frame and pronounced central ridge provide maximum protection.
A round shield with a green background and Blythar’s serpent symbol painted upon it. This medium-sized wooden shield can be used in many ways, depending on the wielder’s skill.
Treasured by those who flirt with life and death, it's said the marrow topper keeps the contents potent and fresh.

A torch made from crystals condensed within the sulfur of Hell. When carried, its distinct foul odor spreads faintly along with an inexplicable aura. Take care not to stare at its eerie yellow flame for too long.
A brazier imbued with the wisdom of the ancients. Runic patterns crafted to command fire are engraved upon its surface, and the flames within glow a mysterious blue.
Enjoy the unique flavor of a fish hauled up from the deep sea. Once you take a bite, its bizarre appearance will be the last thing on your mind.
Flames dance around remnants of the fallen. Some adventurers even reported that those who warm their hands here might just catch whispers from the other side.
A campfire fueled by brimstone crystals. Sit before its faint yellowish glow, and an inexplicable heat will slowly course through your veins.
A green, bubbling brew churns within the cauldron, reeking of rot and despair. Its stench twists the stomach and lingers in the mind.
A campfire awarded to those who have surpassed countless rivals. Engraved with symbols of victory and glory, its blazing flames honor the champion's triumph.

Burning with sinister hues from the depths of the Dark Forest, its unearthly glow casts shadows that dance with malevolent intent, the flames licking at the darkness with a hunger that cannot be sated.

Enkindled by ancient stones, this mystical campfire pulses with magic, radiating a comforting warmth and light that flicker like traditional flames, while preserving the forest’s bounty and enchanting every traveler who draws near.

This campfire burns with a crimson glow under the influence of an ancient magic circle. The circle is inscribed with ancient runes symbolizing light and fire, which shimmer in unison with the rising flames.

This campfire is made from the ancient Tree of Life, a sacred symbol of the Goddess of Compassion. Its beautiful tri-colored flames burn brightly, radiating a warm, uplifting energy that encourages those gathered around it to care for one another and come together as one.
A whole pig slowly turns over the campfire, roasting to a golden brown. The mouthwatering aroma fills the air, irresistible to anyone with a nose.
A sacred campfire woven from the leaves of a blessed tree and imbued with a quiet, solemn presence. Its golden flames shine all the more brilliantly as the darkness deepens.
Casting a captivating display of frost and fire, its glacial blue flames flicker with an otherworldly allure, transforming any campsite into a mystical sanctuary amidst the frozen wilderness.
Imbued with souls of the damned, this infernal flame burns as unholy as the adventurers it once engulfed. Staring deeply into this pit may grant a glimpse of what lies on the other side.
A kettle perches over the flickering heat, promising a comforting brew.
Its flames dance with hues of blue, casting a mesmerizing glow that speaks of triumph over darkness and the promise of new horizons.
A mystical campfire kindled with imbued, radiant gemstones. As the three gems resonate with one another, they create a beautifully woven flame of many colours.
The purple flames arise when the air brims with otherworldly magic. This mystical glow serves as a reminder to stay ready, as the unseen forces surrounding you may harbor both peril and potential.
A succulent rabbit roasts on a spit, filling the air with a mouthwatering aroma.
Flickering with a cold, otherworldly light from another realm, the Spectral Campfire casts a pallid glow that beckons the brave and chills the unwary.
A campfire shaped in the likeness of a small volcano. When kindled, red lava bursts from its crater yet despite its convincing appearance it carries only a gentle warmth and gives no cause for fear.
A merry feast over open flames fills the air, blending holiday cheer with the warmth of the fire... just be sure to carve quickly—who knows what the smell might attract.
Striped like the season’s finest sweets, this torch carries the warmth of holiday cheer, lighting the way with a festive glow.
This torch belongs to one who has claimed a great victory. Covered in spikes and chains, its brutal form resembles a weapon and exudes an overwhelming presence.
A bandage contaminated by the sulfurous fumes of the Inferno. Wrapping it around a wound dulls the pain, but frequent use is not good for the body.

This heart is wrapped in thick rugged hide and holds a strong primal instinct for survival unique to its kind. The wearer slowly becomes one with its will, growing to revere strength and put survival above all else.
A lantern crafted in the likeness of a demon's head from black iron. A sinister green glow burns in its eyes, while ominous smoke seeps from its snarling maw, slowly consuming the air around it.
Wrapped in enchanted vines, this torch casts a luminous, flame-like light, powered by a unique elven stone that radiates warmth without burning its environs.
A well-balanced arming sword imbued with an unquenchable flame. Smoldering heat seeps through the cracks running along the center of the blade.
A bardiche imbued with an unquenchable flame. Heat flowing along the cracks spread across its massive curved blade warms the surrounding air.
A crystal sword imbued with an unquenchable flame. Scorching heat seeps through the red fractures spread across the blade through which magic flows.
A felling axe imbued with an unquenchable flame. Crimson fractures spread across its heated blade, giving the weapon a more savage presence.
A flanged mace imbued with an unquenchable flame. Red heat rests within the cracks along its crown-shaped edges, giving it a savage presence.
A longbow imbued with an unquenchable flame. Warmth carried from the cracks in its yew stave spreads along the leather grip, keeping the wielder’s hands comfortably warm.
A longsword imbued with an unquenchable flame. Heat pulsing beneath the cracks running across the blade lends even greater overwhelming force to the solid steel.
A morning star imbued with an unquenchable flame. Scorching cracks spread between its sharpened spikes, delivering a devastating impact with every crushing blow.
A rapier imbued with an unquenchable flame. Fine fractures run along its agile blade, and scorching heat gathers within them.
A rondel dagger imbued with an unquenchable flame. Searing heat runs along the blade to its very tip, piercing even the toughest armor without resistance.
A spear imbued with an unquenchable flame. Heat rising from within climbs along the shaft, and a menacing red glow seeps through the fractured cracks.
A spellbook imbued with an unquenchable flame. Red fractures spread across the leather cover and throughout its pages, and a faint warmth can be felt between them.
A heart frozen through with ceaseless frost. Bearing it sharpens the mind, but it may make you seem cold and unfeeling to those around you.
Crafted from eternal ice, its luminous radiance penetrates the deepest darkness. Within its core, an icy defiance of nature emanates, exuding an unearthly chill that murmurs ancient secrets.
Its icy exterior shimmers with a celestial glow, promising a taste of the frost-kissed wonders that lie within.

This flame is rumored to be forged from the tears of winter spirits and infused with the essence of ancient frost dragons, imbuing it with an aura both chilling and enchanting.

Hewn from the ancient Tree of Life and blessed by the Goddess of Compassion, this torch stands as a symbol of unity and purpose. It radiates a triad of colors, but only when held by those of true altruism, symbolizing the bearer’s pivotal role in fostering a future filled with light and hope.
A flickering torch with a blinking eye. This eerie eyeball shifts its pupil ceaselessly, gazing upon its surroundings. What it truly sees, no one can ever know.
Adorned with gold plating and ornate jewels, this axe may look like a decoration at first glance, but it is every bit as lethal as any other axe.
Adorned with gold plating and ornate jewels, this knife may look like a decoration at first glance, but it is a fearsome weapon capable of piercing even plate armor.

A lantern shaped like a pumpkin, carved with a mischievous face. Rumor has it that those who meet the orange glow seeping through its features can’t help but feel as if they should offer a piece of candy.
Alight with the Great Harvest’s flame, this torch dances with a lively glow, celebrating the season while its mischievous grin suggests it schemes with tricks and treats in mind.

Shaped like a quill, this torch symbolizes an undying passion. Its flame never truly fades, rekindling with the bearer’s will to illuminate the world. It is said that every word written beneath its glow gains new life.
This lantern holds the flames of the underworld within its maw. If its light flickers for no reason now and then, do not be alarmed. It simply means the lantern is flicking its tongue.
The gathered glow of tiny jellyfish casts a blue radiance that lights up the dark waterways. That light serves as a steadfast guide for those who wander through the depths of the sea.

DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Anchor: An anchor used to moor a ship. Long submerged beneath the sea, it’s now heavily rusted and worn.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_AncientSting: An egg with a thick, leathery shell and horn-like spines jutting from its corners. Within, a fragile life still stirs faintly.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_AntiquatedCo: An ancient coin bearing the marks of time. Its surface, worn smooth by countless hands, is inscribed with letters of unknown meaning.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_AquaglowLant: This lantern emits a light that never goes out, even underwater. With a shining coral at its center, a reflector focuses the light forward, illuminating the dark waters.
