DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ArcaneEssenc: This vivid purple essence is a residue formed when arcane energy fails to disperse into nature. When held close a faint energy can be felt.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ArcaneGarb_0: Intricate runes etched along the seams, rumored to be tailored from cloth infused with whispers of forgotten incantations.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ArcaneGloves: These gloves were stitched from thin yet durable sections of flax and leather, featuring a vibrant blue polished stone whose purpose remains a subject of quiet speculation.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ArcaneHood_0: Its material bears a texture both smooth and unyielding, rumored to be spun from frost-touched silk harvested deep within Frost Mountain.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Armet_0001: Molded heavy movable face and cheek plate armor, fully protecting the head from blows.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ArmillarySph: A device crafted to observe the movements of the sky. Delicately assembled rings and axes rotate slowly, predicting the passage of time and the motion of constellations.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ArmingSword_: A thin blade with leather bindings, supporting a firm grip for hasty attacks that feel light to the hand.
Forged from the flames of a mighty black dragon, this sword claws at the target's soul, inflicting lethal damage.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ArmorScrap: A fragment of the Living Armor’s tarnished armor, pulsating with the haunting energy of battles fought both in life and beyond the veil of the living.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Arrow_2001: An arrow that looks good at penetrating its target.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Awl: A pointed tool used to punch holes in leather or cloth.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_AxeOfRighteo: Every slash carries the weight of moral certainty, a fearsome foe to any who stand in its way.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BadgerPendan: Channel the badger's tenacious spirit with this pendant, designed to amplify your will.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Ball_2001: A heavy iron ball that carries lethal destruction.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Bandage_0001: Bandage used to fix a wound.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BansheeSonne: The faint traces of a sorrowful melody are scrawled on this water-damaged parchment, the ink smeared by rain or perhaps endless tears. The paper feels unnaturally cold, as though a tormented soul clings to it, trapped between worlds.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BarbutaHelm_: The helm forged from a single plate of steel, showing off the craftsman skills.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BardicPants_: A stylish pair of pants that are sure to attract attention at social gatherings.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Bardiche_000: Crafted with a light wooden base that grows wider in order to support an oversized, curved metal blade nailed to it's head.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Bardiche_800: A bardiche forged after the wingbeats of a colossal bird, once hailed as the ruler of the skies. With every swing, a howling gale surges forth and suffers none who stand against it.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BarrelHoop: A metal band used to hold a wooden barrel together.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BatClaw: A hefty claw with an ebony black surface gleaming with a wicked luster.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BatWing: A lightweight souvenir snatched from a startled giant bat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BattleAxe_00: An axe with a strong wooden hilt and a single blade embedded deeply in the wood.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BattleAxe_80: An ancient axe imbued with the screams of fallen enemies, granting its wielder a deadly strength that comes from the echoes of the past.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BattleWornAr: A thick iron plate that once covered the Hell Hunter's massive frame. Dented and scratched across every surface, each mark a testament to the countless battles it has weathered.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Bavin: A medium length of wood cut from a tree.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BearPendant_: Embodying the resilience of the mighty bear, enhancing the wearer's vigor.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BeetleWings: Delicate wings of a death beetle, emanating an aura of darkness and decay.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Bellows: An old set of bellows used to stoke flames in forges or laboratories.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Billet: A small length of wood cut from tree.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Birdcage: A birdcage made of wood. Though not very durable, it is lightweight and easy to carry.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BlackRose_10: The black hue appears unnatural, as though it were forcibly layered over the rose’s original color. Beware of the sharp thorns along its stem.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BlackThreadS: A bundle of black thread neatly wound around a wooden spool.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BlacksmithTo: Tongs used for forging, now stiff with age from long neglect.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BladeOfRight: A well crafted two-handed blade, its silver edge cuts through most things with ease and grace.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BlazingTail: A tail severed by a fire lizard in a moment of peril. The heat of its flames still lingers, and it writhes as if it were still alive.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BlemishedPea: A pearl found within giant clams. Its shape is uneven and marked with small blemishes, yet it holds a subtle, distinctive beauty.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BlessedBarle: It is sacred bread that helps restore health when consumed.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BloodsapBlad: A dark ritual imbued this sword with the essence of a vampire's curse. This blade not only cuts flesh but siphons the spirit, feeding its master with each drop of blood spilled.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BloodwovenGl: Crafted from durable leather, these gloves were soaked in the blood of beasts to achieve their deep crimson color and lasting flexibility.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BloodwovenRo: Rumored to be stitched with threads soaked in the lifeblood of ancient beasts, its crimson tones carry an unsettling warmth.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BlueEyeballs: Enigmatic blue eyeballs plucked from the remnants of a Dire Wolf.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BlueSapphire: The shards of this gem shines a deep blue light.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BlueThreadSp: A bundle of blue thread neatly wound around a wooden spool.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Bolas_0001: A throwing weapon made by attaching stones to both ends of a leather cord. Upon impact, the cord wraps around the target, restricting its movement.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Bolt_2001: A bolt dedicated to crossbows that is sharp enough to pierce opponents.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BoneHelm_000: A bone helm favored by warlocks. Its imposing skull visage strikes deep fear into enemies.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BonePowder: Bone dust left behind where a Dreadspine's body was destroyed. It has an unusually heavy texture that resists scattering, and gives off a faint sheen when exposed to light.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Boneshaper_5: Crafted to honor the immense, in battle it brutally reshapes the bones of the wielder’s enemies.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BowOfRighteo: This bow, adorned with silver inlay, offers an elegant balance of form and function for skilled archers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Bowstring: Well-worn fibers that has witnessed countless arrows fly.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrandoftheSu: A circular leather medallion engraved with a sigil to bind a Fiendling. This brand enforces absolute obedience to a superior demon and cannot be removed as long as its wearer still lives.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BraveHunterP: Crafted using both rugged components and mystical textiles, capturing both durability and mystique.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BreathOfTheD: This potion disturbs the rest of the dead and awakens a longing for life once more. If poured upon the pentagram hidden somewhere in the crypt, it can summon a lich.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Brimstone: A dirty chunk of rock streaked with pale yellow traces of sulfur.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrimstoneOre: A dirty chunk of rock bearing traces of yellowish brimstone
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrimstonePow: Powder made by finely grinding brimstone.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenBoneSp: A broken fragment of a bone spike from a Dreadspine. Its sharpened tip still carries a deadly edge.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenFrame: A framed painting depicting a rough sea. It appears to have been damaged during a shipwreck.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenGlasse: A pair of glasses with no known owner. One lens is shattered, rendering them unusable.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenJarSha: A small shard of pottery from a broken jar.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenPickax: The blade is completely worn down, making it unusable.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenSkull: An imperfect skull with visible fractures.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenTelesc: The front end of a broken telescope. The cracked lens and scratched body hint at the years it has endured.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenWarHor: This horn is a faithful replica of the one a warlord once used to lead his armies long ago. When blown atop the pentagram inscribed somewhere in the crypt, a deep, resonant sound echoes forth, calling the warlord from beyond.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenWheel: A wheel fallen from a broken cart. The spokes are damaged but it could still be repaired and used.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BrokenWooden: A shattered fragment of a wooden barrel, completely unusable.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BronzeLadle: A ladle made of bronze. Used for melting metal or scooping out liquids.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BronzeScale: A set of bronze scales used for measuring the weight of various materials.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Broom: A broom crafted from trimmed, slender branches bound tightly at the base.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BuckledBoots: Featuring sturdy leather construction and ornate metal buckles and fastenings for a secure and adjustable fit.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Buckler_0001: A small shield with a handle located directly behind the boss, guarding oneself in close-quarter combat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Buckler_8001: Created by a mad alchemist, using dragon's blood in some of his creations. Beware, its side effects can be just as potent as they are perilous.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_BugShell: A preserved sturdy shell from a death beetle.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ButtonedBoot: Reinforced with heavy stitching, these boots feature a slight heel for balance and a row of decorative buttons along the sides.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ButtonedLegg: Woven for comfort and practicality, the buttons at the bottom suggest a design meant to allow flexibility or fit adjustments.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Bycocket_000: A bycocket made famous by a renowned ranger. Its sharp brim and decorative feather lend it a stylish and refined look.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CampfireKit_: A crackling campfire that you can rest near and recover.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CandyCane_70: The magic of the season is wrapped within every peppermint twist of these candy canes. They're not just a treat for the taste buds but a treasure trove of winter delight and unexpected value.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CandyCorns_7: Savor the spirit of spookiness with these tri-colored candy corn treats, a sugary staple that adds a dash of fun to every ghostly gathering.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CaptainsCorr: A key long submerged beneath the sea, its surface heavily rusted. It may have once belonged to one of the many shipwrecked captains.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CapturedEner: A small shard of energy left behind as a Demon Imp dissipated. It holds an unstable essence of darkness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CapturedMana: Luminescent flakes radiating a soft glow and carrying traces of otherworldly magic.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CastillonDag: Crafted with a fine blade narrowing to a sharp point. The hilts riveted design ensuring a firm grip.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CaveTrollsPr: A smooth, round stone with no notable features beyond its shape and surface. It appears to be a treasured item to a cave troll.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CentaurHoof: This ebony black Centaur hoof, once traversing the fiery depths of forbidden realms, still carries traces of blood in its remaining fur tufts, serving as a dark souvenir from a hellish world.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CentaurMadne: Inlaid with fragments of a centaur’s horn, harnessing pure power.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CeremonialDa: An ornate dagger with more style than substance.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CeremonialHe: Meticulously designed with sorcerers in mind, this piece is crafted from lightweight yet durable fabric and adorned with intricate gold embroidery.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CeremonialSt: Carved from blessed wood, its branches unfurl in a graceful mimicry of nature's own design—antlers reaching towards the heavens.
Carved from blessed wood, its branches unfurl in a graceful mimicry of nature's own design—antlers reaching towards the heavens.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ChampionArmo: It is said, good armor on your back is sometimes better and more reliable than the companions you adventure with.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ChapelDeFer_: Crafted with reinforced metals showcasing a broad rimmed style helmet with an open face.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Chaperon_000: Made from wool, nice and thick to keep your head warm while adventuring.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Charcoal: Partially burnt charcoal, with a faint glow still lingering beneath the ash.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CharmofFortu: A charm woven from the feathers of a Cockatrice and an Ice Harpy. It is said to hold the power to keep fortune from escaping, bringing small miracles to those who possess it.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CharredFang: It is a blackened fang taken from a Fire Hound. More robust than the teeth of ordinary beasts, it retains its sharpness even under intense heat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ChocolateChi: A deceptively simple chocolate chip muffin with incredible taste, thanks to Jake's magical ingredient that keeps it fresh forever.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Chroniclesof: Deep within the Enchanted Dark Forest, a castle shadows a story where an altruistic king's ambition spiraled into darkness. Obsessed with immortality, he sought the mythical Midnight Stag to gain demigod like powers. His tragic transformation into the Ghost King unfolds as a poignant tale of noble intentions leading to ruin, echoing through the cursed halls.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ClarityPotio: It clears the clouded mind and brings back forgotten memories.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CloakofDarkn: A cloak crafted using enchanted materials tainted with darkness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ClothPants_0: Comfy cloth pants, not offering much as far as protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Club_0001: Simple and effective, this solid wood club is a go-to for those who prefer straightforward, reliable weaponry.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Coal: A dirty chunk of rock marked with black traces of coal.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltChapel: Beautiful craftsmanship, shaping Cobalt steel into a broad rimmed style helmet with an open face.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltFrock_: A frock shimmering with a mesmerizing blue glow that adds a Cobalt layer of protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltHat_40: A shimmering blue hat that was made from fusing Cobalt into the materials for added strength.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltHeavyG: Sturdy and advanced hand armor crafted from Cobalt plated steel.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltHood_4: A hood cut from blue fabric made with Cobalt.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltIngots: A highly enriched ingot of pure Cobalt.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltLeathe: Thick durable leather gloves crafted from mixing Cobalt infused materials in the dye.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltLightf: Made with light durable leather coated in cobalt, enabling swift movements.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltOres_4: A dirty chunk of rock containing traces of shimmering blue cobalt.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltPlateB: Heavy plate boots forged with Cobalt that provide complete foot protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltPlateP: These plate pants made of Cobalt infused steel are like a fortress for the legs.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltPowder: Powder made by finely grinding Cobalt ore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltRegalG: A beautifully assembled padded chest of armor made from combining Cobalt dyes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltTempla: A high-quality Templar chest, made with a mix of Cobalt ingots and fabrics infused with Cobalt dyes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltTrouse: Cobalt coated woven wool trousers, offering a strong yet flexible fit.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CobaltViking: Reinforced Cobalt steel covering the face and leather overlaid with a tight knit Cobalt chainmail.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CockatriceEg: A deep amethyst egg, flecked with myriad tiny spots, lies before thee. With gentle care and tender affection, ‘tis said the egg may yet be persuaded to hatch.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CockatricesL: Legends speak of the Cockatrice's Lucky Feather, its vibrant crimson hue rumored to hold mysterious powers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Coif_0001: A simple coif of supple fabric, its faint gold trim a quiet nod to its wearer's refined mastery of the arcane arts.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ConchShell: A spiral shell that holds the sound of the sea. When held to your ear, you can hear the sound of waves.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperIngots: A highly enriched ingot of pure Copper.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperOres_3: A dirty chunk of rock containing traces of copper.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperPowder: Powder made by finely grinding Copper ore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperlightA: Blending functionality with a touch of wanderlust, this attire incorporates copper elements for durability, perfect for those who travel far and wide.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperlightG: Sturdy gauntlets made of solid copper, providing excellent protection and a gleaming, battle-ready appearance.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperlightK: This Copper Kettle Hat, with its polished, rounded design, resembles a classic kettle, offering a practical headwear choice.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperlightL: Crafted from supple leather with embedded copper fibers, provide a perfect fusion of durability and style.
These boots combine the lightness needed for rapid movement with the added resilience of copper.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperlightO: A mystical tunic interwoven with copper, designed for those who delve into the arcane. It resonates with an aura of mystery and occult power.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperlightP: These pants blend the conductivity of copper with a comfortable fit, ideal for rituals and mystical explorations.
Boots that are reinforced with solid copper plates, offering exceptional protection for demanding terrains and battles.
Reinforced with copper plates, offer exceptional protection, ideal for adventurers seeking both safety and style.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperlightR: Crafted for resilience, these gloves feature copper rivets, suitable for various demanding tasks.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperlightS: This fashionable copper plate armor is heavy and strong, good against physical as well as magical attacks.
Designed for the stealthy and stylish, this hood is made with copper-woven fabric, giving it a mysterious, shadowy look with a hint of shimmer.
Crafted from straw melded with copper, it's a sturdy, stylish choice for outdoor wear.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CopperlightT: A durable and versatile tunic, infused with copper fibers. Adventurous style suitable for any journey.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CoralFragmen: A piece of coral grown beneath the sea. Its surface is hard and has a unique texture.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CoreofCinder: A core left behind after a fire elemental’s death. Ash formed as its form burned during the moment of dissolution clings to it.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CorruptedHea: The corrupted heart of the Midnight Stag, still pulsating with dark energies, is said to have once tempted the king of these lands with promises of immense power. He succumbed, and paid dearly. Beware its seductive pull, lest you too fall victim to its curse.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CourtlyDress: An attire crafted from fine, soft fabric. Accented with a leather vest and an embroidered shoulder cape, it completes the dignified air befitting the court.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CowlofDarkne: Crafted using forbidden fibers, the cowl's material holds the unsettling after touch of darkness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrackedLog: A large damaged log cut from a tree.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrackedTusk: A flame boar’s tusk. Unable to withstand the intense heat, its surface is cracked in several places.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrimsonThrea: A bundle of red thread neatly wound around a wooden spool.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrocodilianE: This yellow eye retains the reptilian trait of a vertical slit pupil, casting an unsettling sense of pressure upon those who meet its gaze.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Crossbow_000: A powerful mechanical weapon, a single-shot crossbow with a crank that's very abrasive to the hand.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrownoftheMi: The crown of the elusive Midnight Stag exuded a sinister aura, a poignant emblem of the darkness this creature inadvertently propagated through these lands.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrusaderArmo: Armor that allows for defensive and offensive movements. Protection against physical and magical attacks.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrusaderHelm: A distinctive helmet adorned with a cross-shaped visor, a symbol of unwavering faith.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrystalBall_: A dense glass ball made of mysterious origins, able to harness and focus magical energy.
Unable to defeat a hopelessly powerful demi-god, an ancient sorcerer sacrificed his life to seal one of the demi-god's eyes in a crystal ball.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrystalFrost: A shard of eternal winter trapped in cobalt, this ring saps warmth from the wearer’s soul, leaving behind only ice and silence.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CrystalSword: An enigma to what materials this blade is composed of, allowing magic to flow through it.
A sword forged from the shards of the Ice Queen's tears. Though fragile and prone to breaking, its fierce icy blade summons delicate whirlwinds of snowflakes, reforming itself to its original form.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CuffedBoots_: Constructed from sturdy leather, these boots feature a folded cuff at the top, designed for added flexibility and style.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CursedBandag: A bloodstained bandage, steeped in the pain and screams of those lost to a horrific experiment. Offer it to the Nightmare Mummy, who will cleanse it and pray for the dead.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CursedBell_7: When this bell is rung, a clear chime echoes out, but faintly within it is a sound like the dying scream of the Midnight Stag. If the bell is sounded atop the pentagram drawn somewhere within the Inferno, it will summon the Ghost King.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CursedCrown: A majestic crown befitting the ruler of this domain, forever the eternal sovereignty over the darkness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Cutlass_0001: A blade curved with a gentle arc, perfected for slashing. Its finely honed tip was designed to catch and turn aside an opponent’s weapon in the midst of battle.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CuttlefishIn: A pouch filled with the jet-black ink released in moments of danger. When used as ink, it retains its deep color for a long time.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CyclopsClub: A massive bludgeon, carved from ancient trees, embodying the might of the one-eyed behemoths.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CyclopsEye: A colossal ocular relic, a dark souvenir from the realm of one-eyed beings.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CyclopsPreci: A small hand mirror crafted in an antique style. One corner is broken, rendering it useless as a mirror. It appears to be a treasured item to a cyclops.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CyclopsRags: Frayed attire from a cyclops, made up of rough fabrics and scavenged materials.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_CyclopsVisio: Infused with the essence of a Cyclops eye, merging the undeniable strength with the mysteries of arcane magic.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DaggerOfRigh: Featuring minimalistic silver designs, is perfect for those who value subtlety and effectiveness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkCassock_: A cassock reserved for the high clergy. Dark in hue, it is adorned with a crimson stole edged in gold, a symbol of authority.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkCuirass_: Forged from obsidian-infused steel offering exceptional protection, shielding its wearer from devastating blows.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkLeatherL: Crafted from supple, dark leather that melds seamlessly with the night.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkMatter: Concentrated particles of dark matter, exuding an otherworldly energy that defies comprehension.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkMatterTu: Interwoven with arcane materials, this garment harnesses its core strength from dark matter derived from malevolent sources—don it with caution.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkPaddedHo: Dark-colored hose, lightly padded for warmth and impact absorption.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkPlateArm: This fashionable dark plate armor is heavy and strong, good against physical as well as magical attacks.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkgroveHoo: Made from treated leather, designed for durability and resilience in outdoor environments, its design subtly inspired by nature.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkgroveRob: A robe crafted from natural fibers, imbued with the essence of the forest. Its earthy tones and soft texture resonate with the tranquility of nature.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DarkleafBoot: Renowned for their unique blend of flexibility and durability, a testament to the craftsmanship of woodland artisans.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DashingBoots: Crafted with sleek lines and a polished finish, providing a comfortable and glove-like fit that allows for effortless movement.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DeathstepBoo: Boots designed solely for speed. The sole uses the light, springy shell of an insect, while the outer layer is lined with delicate wings. When worn, the wearer moves with a gliding swiftness, but the boots offer no protection. Taking even a single hit can be crippling. Suited for those who must move fast, even at great risk.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DemonBlood: A vial filled with the corrupted life essence of a demon, pulsating with evil energy.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DemonDogThor: Needle-like points ready to deliver a painful reminder of the creatures that bore them.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DemonGripGlo: Crafted with high-tensile materials, augmented by demonic fragments, exhibiting near-sentient tendencies.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DemonWingMem: The remains of a wing once used to drift through the air. Despite its thin and stretched form, it is surprisingly tough.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DemoncladLeg: Crafted using demonic remnants, granting it a malevolent sentience.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DemonsGlee_5: A blade fused with unholy blood is said to become almost sentient, craving destruction.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Diamond_1001: A beautiful rock that scatters light in a vibrant ray of dancing colors.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DiaryoftheTo: The king's former court wizard, composed this haunting diary detailing his descent into the darkest arcane arts to satisfy the king’s sinister ambitions. His quest for forbidden knowledge turned him into a Lich, eternally chained to the castle he cursed with his master, a chilling reflection on the price of unwavering loyalty to dark magic.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DivineAxe_40: A formidable double-sided axe with silver adornments, combining raw power with a raw power.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DivineBlade_: A weapon of divine retribution, its hefty weight is balanced by the precision with which it cleaves through foes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DivineBow_40: With its silver-infused craftsmanship, this bow is as visually striking as it is effective.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DivineDagger: The silver detailing on this dagger elevates its appeal, making it a prized possession for any skilled wielder.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DivineRod_40: With its simple silver inclusions, this mace is a solid choice for those facing undead opponents.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DivineShortS: A straightforward weapon, its silver edge makes it a dependable choice in combat against undead entities.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DivineStaff_: Expertly crafted, is an ideal fusion of power and grace, suitable for both defensive and offensive maneuvers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DivineWater: A vial of divine water that helps restore a small amount of health.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DoctorsBag: An old medical bag, now empty inside.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DogCollar: Tangible proof of your triumph over the menacing beasts that roam the shadows.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DoubleAxe_00: This heavy formidable weapon is capable of delivering devastating blows from both ends.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DoubleAxe_80:
Death comes for us all one day...
Is today that day?
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Doublet_0001: Lightweight and breathable. Typically favored by those who prefer to blend in.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DreadHood_40: Crafted using the remnants of the demonic, imbuing it with a thirst for devastation.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Drum_0001: Assembled from a sturdy wooden frame with stretched hide over both ends, filling the air with rhythmic vibrations.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_DryadMask_00: A wooden mask carved in the image of a dryad. It is used in forest rites to pray for a successful hunt.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Ectoplasm: Emitting an otherworldly glow, this ectoplasm pulses with secrets from beyond the veil. Many are drawn to its mysterious energy and covet its elusive power.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ElkwoodCrown: Combining the durability of leather with the elegance of nature, this hat, adorned with branch-like antlers, is a stylish nod to the wilderness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ElkwoodGlove: These gloves feature antler embellishments, a mark of the forest's blessing.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_EmberGem: It is a gem that holds a smoldering ember within. It is finely cut, as if crafted to fit perfectly somewhere.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Emerald_1001: A radiant rock of mesmerizing green.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_EnchantedDar: A mystical fabric woven in the depths of darkness, radiating an otherworldly aura.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_EnchantedEye: An eye specialized for observing enemies from great distances. Even after its owner's death, the mana condensed within keeps it glowing faintly in the dark.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_EtchedWandFr: A fragment broken from the staff of a Tidewalker shaman. Its surface is etched with indecipherable symbols and markings, and it carries a shamanic aura similar to that of the seaweed necklace.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ExplosiveBot: A bottle containing a flammable mixture that explodes when ignited and thrown.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ExtraThickPe: This pelt boasts an exceptional thickness, offering unparalleled protection against the biting cold.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Eyepatch: An eyepatch made of leather. Used to cover a wound or protect the eye.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FabricShears: Heavy shears designed for cutting large bolts of fabric. The long, weighted blades require a skilled hand to use properly.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FairysRequie: This spellbook, written in the language of the fae, is filled with a melody of sorrow. The reader instinctively understands its emotions, but must take care not to lose themselves to the book’s overwhelming grief.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Falchion_000: A curved iron blade and broad hilt, the curvature of the blade is foreign and enigmatic.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Falchion_800: Seems the great black dragon has lost a tooth... No matter, it will continue its bloody purpose.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FalchionofHo: There is no question of honor or skill for those whom wield this blade.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FangsofDeath: Necklace crafted using a unique combination of teeth acquired from different beasts.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FeatheredHat: A fashionable hat crafted with soft, silky feathers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FellingAxe_0: Forged with aged wood and sturdy metal, it's rigid blade can cut through most surface.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FellingAxe_8: Through a bond that transcended realms, a guardian of souls granted a mortal companion this enchanted axe.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FineCuirass_: This armor makes living in impossible situations suddenly possible. Plate armor, uncomfortable to wear and quite heavy.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FireflyAbdom: A preserved firefly's abdomen, emitting a radiant beacon of light.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FlameGasBag: This is a specialized organ located beneath the lungs of a Cockatrice. It contains the gas once used to breathe fire.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FlangedMace_: A slow and heavy mace designed with crown-shaped blunt edges, supporting even reckless swings.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FlickeringEm: A small ember left behind by a fire spirit. It does not easily go out and faint whispers can be heard if you listen closely.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Flute_0001: It is carefully carved into a slender frame made of treated cedar.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ForestBoots_: The boots' color palette is designed to blend harmoniously with forest surroundings.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ForestHood_0: A hood that looks like it can hide well in the leaves.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FoulBoots_40: Assembled from the tail fibers of a centaur, augmented with maggots, and activated by demonic elements.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FoxPendant_3: Designed to enhance ones nimbleness, echoing the fox’s swift and graceful movements.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FranciscaAxe: A Lightweight small throwing axe that can take out enemies from a distance.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Frock_0001: Made with broadcloth, a much heavier wool. Humble and modest.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostAmulet_: Radiating a frosty aura, allowing one to deliver more potent sharpness to their physical blows.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostStoneIn: A highly enriched ingot of pure Froststone, it maintains an unyielding cold even in the fiercest heat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostStoneOr: A chunk of raw material that pulses with the eternal cold of the frozen abyss.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostStonePo: Powder made by finely grinding Froststone ore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostWyvernC: These razor-sharp talons, forged from glacial ice, are as formidable as the beasts that wield them.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostWyvernE: Mystical egg, cool to the touch, encapsulating the delicate balance of fragility and resilience.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostWyverns: A dense, frost-encrusted layer torn from the icy beast's form. It gleams with the frozen essence of the abyss, a testament to the Wyvern's mastery over the icy expanse.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostbittenM: A hammer forged from the essence of cold gathered from the monsters of Frost Mountain. It is the only weapon capable of shattering the sealed wyvern statue, which no ordinary weapon can break. Once the statue is destroyed, the Frost Wyvern will awaken.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostedFeath: This feather, taken from the Ice Harpy’s wings and covered in an eternal layer of frost, embodies the icy spirit of its frigid realm.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightAb: A striking set of plate armor forged from a rare ore that pulses with eternal frost, providing both a stalwart defense and an intimidating presence.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightAk: A quilted armor pulsing with the cold of the frozen abyss, offering flexible protection that adapts to the wearer's movements.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightCl: Crafted from fabrics touched by the eternal chill, this cloak offers a serene yet powerful presence, echoing the quiet strength of ancient ice.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightCr: An imposing crusader helm crafted from Froststone Ingots, intertwining the chilling touch of the frozen abyss with the enduring might of the noble and the devout.
Skillfully crafted and imbued with the enduring cold of Froststone, this crystal sword seamlessly integrates magic, transforming into an adept vessel for arcane power.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightFe: A charming hat infused with Froststone Powder, merging the perpetual frost of the frozen abyss with the quick-witted finesse of the nimble and clever.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightGa: Forged from mystical Froststone, these gauntlets meld the biting chill of eternal ice with a rugged, battle-ready construction.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightHo: A sleek hood crafted from Froststone Powder, intertwining the frigid touch of the frozen abyss with dark allure.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightLa: This shield emanates an everlasting cold that remains steadfast even in the most intense environments. Its retractable blade and lantern offer invaluable support for combat and exploration.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightLe: Crafted from reinforced leather and suffused with timeless cold, these leggings offer agile movement with the glacial strength of the abyss.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightLi: Light and durable, these leather boots are imbued with the arcane resilience of froststone, ensuring swift movement through diverse challenges.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightMy: Exquisitely crafted and intricately designed, these gloves draw from the frozen abyss, allowing spellcasters to wield their magic with finesse.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightNo: A fierce helm wrought from Froststone Ingots, merging the glacial force of the frozen abyss with the primal fury of its bearer.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightOr: A flowing robe imbued with the frost of ancient realms, enhancing the wearer’s mystical presence with an ethereal chill.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightPl: Provides formidable protection, powered by the icy essence of the frozen abyss, though their clunkiness might slow you down a bit.
Sturdy plate pants forged from froststone ore, integrating the icy resilience of the frozen abyss into every plate and rivet.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightRi: Riveted with enchanted froststone, these gloves offer a seamless blend of the abyss's icy power and rugged durability.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightRu: Combining thick leather and compact fur lining, these boots are infused with froststone’s chilling essence, offering both warmth and formidable durability.
These leather gloves, inlaid with froststone facets, offer a perfect blend of flexibility and the frigid power of mystical frozen ice.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightSp: This spear combines the piercing power of a traditional spear with the icy might of the frozen abyss, making each attack chillingly effective.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightTr: Woven from light, enchanted fabric, these trousers are permeated with infinite freeze, offering both dexterity and the relentless chill of the glacial depths.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightWa: A War Maul forged from refined Froststone. The frozen head is strong enough to shatter any metal, and its icy chill seeps into the wielder’s hands. Thick gloves are essential to wield it.
An ensemble that blends the resilience of the frozen abyss with the natural agility of the wilderness, offering a balance of strength and flexibility.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrostlightWi: An exquisite creation fashioned from Froststone Powder, combining the chilling power of the frozen abyss with arcane elegance.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrozenClaw: A claw that fell from an Ice Hound. Though its tip is slightly chipped from the aftermath of a fierce struggle, a lingering chill still clings to it.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrozenHeart: From the lifeless blue heart of the already deceased Wendigo, emanates a chilling aura of ruthless death, pulsating with a faint heartbeat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_FrozenIronKe: A weathered iron key encased in frost, hinting at locked mysteries buried in the coldest reaches.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GallantOutfi: An attire crafted for courtly feasts and ceremonies. With puffed sleeves and tooled leather decorations, it gives a more splendid impression.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GamblersToke: A magical token that is crafted upon entering the most dangerous dungeons. Extracting with this token is a testament to an adventurer’s grit and toughness. These high value tokens can be redeemed for gold upon escape.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GemNecklace_: This silver necklace with such a magnificent red stone was clearly made for Royalty.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GemRing_1001: This gold ring, adorned with a gleaming jade gem, is the epitome of wealth and luxury.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GhostdustPou: A small pouch, yet within it lies dust that holds the power to uncover secrets. Throw it, and watch as the invisible become visible, bathed in golden light.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GhostlyEssen: Spiritual residue, harvested from a powerful vanquished apparition. Its spectral hue hints at the ethereal energies pulsating within.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GiantBatEar: These tiny sensory receptors amplify sound vibrations and facilitate precise auditory processing.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GiantBatHide: A pelt with a velvety texture.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GiantHorn: This large horn is coated with sticky clumps of the Inferno’s rot, so caution is needed when handling it barehanded.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GiantToe: A severed toe from a giant, its nail discolored and emitting a faint odor that lingers in the air.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GingerbreadC:
"Run, run, run, fast as you can. You can't catch me, I'm the Gingerbread Man!"
- G.B.M
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Gjermundbu_0: Reinforced metal that cover most of the head and face, transitioning to flexible chainmail for lower half.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GlovesOfUtil: Sturdy utilitarian gloves allowing for good grip and quick interaction with objects.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GlowingBlueI: Shimmering with a blue glow, these eerie orbs retain the same coldness as their spectral gaze.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GlowingOrang: This eyeball, taken from the corpse of a Cerberus, holds an ominous orange glow.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoatHideRug: A rug crafted from carefully treated goat hide. Its natural shape and fur texture remain largely intact.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoblinEars: Goblins regard their ears as more than simple features; these appendages are revered as symbols of status and honor. The severed ears collected from fallen goblins are tangible proof of triumph.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldBangle1I: A flamboyant bracelet for the rich.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldBangle1J: An elaborate and ornamented golden band.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldBangle2D: A flashy and sumptuous gold bracelet.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldBangle2G: An elegant golden band of metal to be worn around the wrist.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldBangle2H: A brilliant gilded band of gold.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldCandelab: A splendid method to display your wealth and light up the room.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldCandleHo: A fancy holder for expensive wax candles.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldCandlePl: A fine platter used to prevent wax from dirtying the floor.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldChaliceA: A wonderful container for some well balanced wine.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldChaliceB: A little too extravagant for just common ale.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldCoinBag_: A bag capable of holding a hefty amount of gold coins.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldCoinChes: A chest that can hold a lot of gold coins.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldCoinPouc: A pouch that can hold quite a bit of gold coins.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldCoinPurs: A purse that can hold golden coins.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldCoins_70: A gold coin that emits a beautiful golden color.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldCrown_10: Heavy is the head that wears this crown.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldIngots_5: A highly enriched ingot of pure gold.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldOres_500: A dirty chunk of rock containing traces of gleaming gold.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldPowder_5: Powder made by finely grinding gold ore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldWaterpot: Used to water very fancy plants.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenArmet_: Molded from gold with movable face and cheek armor, fully protecting the head from blows.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenBoots_: Heavy-duty boots crafted from robust gold, lined with dense, golden woolly fur, offering both unparalleled durability and luxurious warmth.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenChauss: Golden leather pants that provide flexible protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenCloak_: Crafted from fine golden fibers, this luxurious cloak is a mark of high status.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenFellin: A luxuriously crafted axe with a golden sharp edge ensures practical utility alongside its ornamental value.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenGauntl: Made from fine gold plates offering maximum protection for your digits.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenGjermu: Reinforced with gold that covers most of the head and face, transitioning to flexible golden chainmail.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenGloves: Made with thick yet flexible golden hide. Adjustable wrist bracing offering extra support and reinforcement.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenHounsk: A gold helmet that provides extensive protection for the face.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenKey_70: An intricate golden key that may lead to priceless treasure.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenLeafHo: Crafted with golden fabrics helping you blend into your environment with ease.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenLeggin: Made using a much thicker, heavier golden infused leather. Added protection over the knees.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenPadded: Made from quilting golden materials, offering flexible soft armor that allows for mobility with ease.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenPlateB: Provides physical protection made from heavy golden plates however, definitely harder to sneak around in.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenPlateP: Extremely heavy gold plate pants, compromising speed for extra protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenPlate_: Golden Plate armor, extremely strong however, uncomfortable to wear and quite heavy.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenRobe_5: A bewitching garment crafted using materials derived from gold that weaves together style and sorcery.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenScarf_: A facemask woven using golden materials, making the wearer appear mysterious.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenScript: A gaudy scripture forged from a rich man's vanity, shining like the sun when it catches the light. Made entirely of solid gold, cover and pages alike, it is far too heavy to be called a book. It holds no magic despite its sacred form, but its sheer weight makes it a surprisingly dangerous weapon.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenSkullt: A skull token whose golden shimmer illuminates the tale of a thousand adventures.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenTeeth: Crafted from pure gold, symbolizing both refinement and extravagance, a mark of distinction.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GoldenViking: A striking blend of battle-readiness and grandeur, featuring a golden blade, symbolizing both might and wealth.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GrandBrigand: Featuring crafted combination of metal and padded fabric segments.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GraveEssence: The soil from the depths of the grave, holding the whispers of departed souls.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GravewolfGlo: Woven from the pelts of wolves, these gloves resonate with the fierce energy of the wild.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GreatHelm_00: This heavy helm offers a significant amount of protection against head attacks.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GreenThreadS: A bundle of green thread neatly wound around a wooden spool.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GrimSlayer_5: This crimson blade can cut through what cannot be seen, and even those who have long since died and forgotten all sensation writhe once more in agony beneath its edge.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GrimsmileRin: Ring crafted using rare golden teeth extracted from the silenced mouths of defeated rivals.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_GrimveilCloa: Woven from a cursed crypt’s shadows, the Grimveil Cloak shrouds its wearer in darkness, offering salvation at death’s edge.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Halberd_0001: A two handed pole-arm with a long reach, devised with an axe blade containing a sharp spike firmly fasted to the end.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Halberd_8001: It will be difficult to keep track of your kill count for they have all been reduced to a pile of ash.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HandCannon_0: A straight-barreled firearm forged from heavy metal. Though it takes time to reload, its firepower is strong enough to pierce even the thickest armor.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HandCrossbow: A small crossbow that seems suitable for holding and shooting with one hand.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HardCrabShel: The shell of a pinchclaw crab, as hard as stone and difficult to damage even with most weapons.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HardenedShel: A fragment of a lava turtle’s shell with a rugged uneven surface. It is as hard as aged stone and remarkably heavy for its size.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Hatchet_0001: Compact in size and balanced weight makes it easy to wield for both utility and combat purposes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HazeBlade_50: In a late-night escapade, a tipsy wizard and an equally sloshed blacksmith clumsily combined their crafts, spilling enchanted ale on a blade mid-forging. The result was this bewitched sword, leaving foes as befuddled and dazed as its creators on that fateful evening.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HealingPotio: Potion used to recover a bit of health.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HeaterShield: Made from attenuated wood overlaid with leather, providing more defenses and stability against brunt attacks.
Crafted by a powerful and mysterious being to aid in eliminating magic users. He saw wizards lust for magic, fearing they would grow too powerful.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HeavyBoots_0: Heavy duty boots lined with thick wooly fur, that can help the wearer overcome hurdles or stand firm and strong.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HeavyGambeso: Robust padded armor garment, with layers of thick, quilted fabric, offering formidable protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HeavyGauntle: Made from fine plate steel offering maximum protection for your digits.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HeavyLeather: Made using a much thicker, heavier leather. Added protection over the knees.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HellHuntersC: A massive blade darkened by the blood of countless prey soaked in over the years. The edge is rather dull, but its sheer weight alone is enough to crush bone.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Hemostatic_0: A special ointment that can helps in stopping bloodloss
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HerbPouch: A leather pouch made for carrying herbs. Inside are a few herbs, as if someone had gathered them but never finished.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HolyRobe_000: A common wool robe made for those of faith. It may be itchy against the skin but at least you will be warm.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HoneyblissPe: An exquisite pear that reveals a symphony of flavors, with a burst of sweetness and a delicate hint of honeyed nectar in every bite.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HornOfCentau: Obsidian horn of a centaur demon, its ridged surface gleaming with an unearthly darkness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HorsemansAxe: A nimble axe, forged with a thin hilt that makes it suitable for one hand, enabling mobility in battle.
This enchanted axe is crafted by infusing the blood and essence from the third of the legendary Four Horsemen.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Horseshoe: An iron fitting shed from a horse’s hoof. Its underside is worn in many places, bearing witness to countless journeys past.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Hounskull_00: A sheet metal helmet that provides extensive protection for the face.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Hourglass: An hourglass filled with sand inside a transparent glass tube. Time is measured by the falling grains.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HumanRemains: The unidentified remains of a human. Bones lie scattered among filthy soil. Found in the place seen by the leatherworker in his dreams.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HuntingTrap_: A spring-loaded hunting trap, waiting to snap shut on unsuspecting prey.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HuntressGold: An emblem awarded to those who have endured the Huntress’s most arduous assignments. Bearing the radiant brilliance of the sun, this emblem stands as a symbol of an adventurer’s honor and glory.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HuntressSilv: An emblem awarded to those who complete the Huntress’s assignments. This silver emblem, gleaming with the cold clarity of moonlight, bears witness to an adventurer’s courage and relentless resolve.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_HuntressWitn: An emblem bestowed upon those who have carried out the Huntress's many assignments, great and small. Glowing softly with a mysterious violet light, this emblem commemorates the adventurer's storied journey.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Icefang_5001: A blade born of the frozen north, its chilling touch leaves behind frostbitten wounds that are rumored to never thaw.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_InfectedFles: A vile piece of flesh, tainted by insidious infection, emanating a nauseating stench.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_InkwellandQu: A small glass inkwell paired with a feather quill. The tip glides smoothly across the page, but the ink easily smudges if left to dry too slowly.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_IntactSkull: A perfectly preserved skull, devoid of any blemishes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_IntricateWoo: A small wooden figurine delicately carved by hand. The sculptor's artistic spirit can still be felt.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Invisibility: Become invisible when used. The spell is broken when the target moves or performs an action.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_IronChain: A thick iron chain left untouched for years. Its rusted surface gives off a sharp, metallic stench.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_IronIngots_2: A highly enriched ingot of pure iron.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_IronOres_200: A dirty chunk of rock containing traces of iron.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_IronPowder_2: Powder made by finely grinding iron ore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_JellyfishGlo: A gelatinous fluid harvested from a luminous jellyfish. It emits its own light in darkness, its brightness undiminished even in the deepest seas.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_JesterCap_00: A comical jester’s hat with crooked horns, each tipped with a small bauble that jingles noisily with every move.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_JesterOutfit: An outfit of glossy fabric adorned with exaggerated trims. Its comical appearance shines especially in festivals and performances.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_JesterPants_: Pants with different colors on each leg, standing out all the more. With every step, they exude a playful charm.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_JesterPoulai: Shoes with elongated toes and exaggerated ankle adornments, sure to draw the eyes of others wherever you go.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_KettleHat_00: Strong and functional, not only offering protection against head attacks but from bad hair days.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_KneadBloodBa: A blood bag extracted from the body of a Hell Maggot. Clumps of decay and sticky blood are mixed inside, slowly solidifying.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_KoboldEar: Leathery in texture and encased in frost, these ears bear traces of what appears to be black earwax.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_KrampusCoin_: A coin engraved with Krampus’s face. It is a small token of his favor, given only to those who have done good.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_KrampusGolde: This small golden bell, known for its clear and gentle chime, can only be obtained by those who have truly pleased Krampus. It is said that those who ring it are granted a special blessing from him.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_KrampusSilve: This small silver bell, known for its clear and gentle chime, can only be found during the winter when Krampus appears. It is said that those who ring it are granted a small blessing from him.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_KrisDagger_0: A wavy blade that causes multiple jagged wounds with every stab. It's handle, also curved for a better grip.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LacedTurnsho: Thick hide shoes, topped with a blend of cotton and wool laces to ensure a good fit.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LanternShiel: A versatile shield with a retractable blade and a built-in lantern, perfect for combat and exploring shadowy realms.
A versatile shield with a retractable blade and a built-in lantern, perfect for combat and exploring shadowy realms.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Lantern_0001: A lantern useful for lighting up dark paths, enabling for quicker traversal.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Lantern_7001: A lantern useful for lighting up dark paths, enabling for quicker traversal.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LargeScroll_: Filled with ancient writing that may uncover the secrets of the world or might just be the recipe for old fashioned cake.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LavaGolemSho: It is a massive stone fragment that fell from a lava golem’s shoulder. It is far heavier than it appears, requiring considerable strength to move.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LavaMushroom: A unique mushroom found only in the Firedeep. It grows by feeding on the heat of lava zones and has the property of storing heat within its body. Dwarves dry this mushroom over a long period and enjoy it as a snack.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LavishShirt_: A shirt made from subtly lustrous fabric. A patterned scarf draped around it adds a touch of refined style.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LeatherBonne: A fancy leather hat with feathers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LeatherBoot: Worn leather boot weathered by years of sea wind and salt. The surface is cracked and damaged in many places.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LeatherCap_0: Doubled layered leather cap with reinforced stitching.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LeatherChaus: Leather pants that provide flexible protection effective against slashing weapons.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LeatherGlove: Good quality leather with double stitching for reinforcement, nice and snug.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LeatherLamel: Crafted from interlaced leather plates, its scale-like structure offers both protection and flexibility.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LeatherLeggi: Crafted using rough leathers, shaped and sewn to fit the body comfortably.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Lifeleaf_100: Valued for its life-bestowing qualities acquired from soil soaked in blood.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LightAketon_: Crafted from fabrics and reinforced with strategic padding, providing optimal balance between defense and agility.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LightBringer: Those of faith know how to combat darkness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LightCassock: A plain cassock worn by ordinary clergy and monks. Made from coarse, light-colored fabric, it conveys a sense of humility and simplicity.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LightGauntle: Forged from lightweight alloys, offer exceptional hand protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LightfootBoo: Made with light durable leather, allowing one to move swiftly through a variety of obstacles.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Lock: A large, heavy padlock. It looks like it could be used if the right key is found.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Lockpick_200: Lockpicks are versatile tools, capable of opening a wide variety of locks.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LongPipe: A long slender smoking pipe. Burn marks remain at the tip.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Longbow_0001: Carved from yew wood with reinforced leather binds for steady gripping. It strikes from long distances with accuracy.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Longbow_8001: A bow crafted by a legendary tribe of warriors known as the Penobscots. So terrifyingly strong it knocks back their foes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Longsword_00: A very long blade crafted from durable metal with a staunch hilt, heavy yet still feels nimble in your grasp.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Longsword_80: Long ago, a King was gifted this artifact by someone who valued his sense of dream, justice, love and kindness, hoping to help him carve these principles into the world.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LooseTrouser: Extremely light, soft breathable canvas cotton trousers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LowBoots_000: Featuring reinforced seams and double-stitched panels for enhanced durability.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LuckPotion: A potion said to bring good luck when drunk. The origin of the contents is unknown.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LukewarmStew: A half-eaten bowl of stew. It still holds a faint lukewarm heat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Lute_0001: A bard's trusty Lute, capable of soothing savage beasts with enchanting melodies.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_LuxuryBootRa: A sturdy boot tree made of solid wood. It helps maintain the shape of boots, preventing creases and damage.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Lyre_0001: The frame is made of finely polished maple wood and the strings are woven from strong silk.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Maggots: Tiny creatures, tirelessly recycling the remnants of the fallen.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MagicProtect: An effective potion to help aid against magical threats.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MagmaEssence: An essence obtained from lava slimes. It takes the form of a thick liquid and bubbles with heat like magma.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ManaSphere_5: Crafted with mana flakes allowing the currents of magic to flow more freely.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Manuscriptso: Manuscripts of the Warlord: The legacy of the Skeleton Warlord, once a stalwart defender who watched his king succumb to darkness. Now bound as a spectral guardian, he eternally protects and commands the secrets and lingering spirits within the castle’s forsaken walls—a testament to loyalty and the corrosive power of sinister magic.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MarauderOutf: A mix of soft padding for comfort, leather for movability and plate armor for added protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MeltedPickax: A pickaxe head warped by extreme heat. The handle is gone and only the partially melted head remains.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MercurialClo: This cloak's deep navy shade allows one to easily vanish into the shadows, a perfect companion for the stealthy and mysterious.
This cloak's deep navy shade allows one to easily vanish into the shadows, a perfect companion for the stealthy and mysterious.

DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MermaidScale: This scale, taken from the body of a dead mermaid, shimmers beautifully in many colors when it catches the light. Yet the cold aura clinging to it leaves an unsettling chill in the air.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MermaidsTear: This teardrop-shaped, milky-white crystal is usually translucent but turns clear underwater. Some claim it can be taken from a living mermaid, yet most are found on the dead.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MetalCup_100: Has value as long as it can hold a pint of ale.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MidnightStag: This head carries a dark and ominous aura. The hollow eyes of the stag devoid of light cast a somber shadow around it.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MimicTooth: The jagged incisor of a mimic, a twisted reminder of its ability to transform and ensnare unsuspecting adventurers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MisshapenBla: A shard of the blade formed from the grotesque mutation of a Demon Executioner's arm. Its surface resembles organic tissue at first glance, yet its hardness surpasses that of most ores.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Mitre_0001: A hat worn by high clergy, adorned with gilded leather and amethysts that enhance its splendor.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MoldyBread: A bread with a flourishing ecosystem of molds and fungi, a questionable delicacy for adventurous eaters.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MonkeyPendan: This pendant offers a boost in dexterity, ideal for tasks requiring precision and quick reflexes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MorningStar_: Heavy to the hand, the sharpened spikes of this morningstar are perfect for bludgeoning attacks.
Gifted to a holy fighter long ago by a demi-god, proving faith is also a powerful weapon, crushing all non-believers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MysteriousPo: Its purpose is unclear, and it’s best not to drink it without knowing what it does.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MysticGloves: Delicate and adorned with intricate designs, allowing spellcasters to maintain precise control over their magical energies.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MysticVestme: Perfect attire for any mystic, cozy and functional, all while maintaining the mysterious vibe.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_MysticalGem: A beautiful jewel that shines mysteriously. There are elaborate parts that seem to fit somewhere.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Navigational: A compass that shows direction anywhere. The red-painted metal needle always points north.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_NecklaceOfPe: Infused with a tranquil energy, increases your maximum health.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_NormanNasalH: Crafted with a distinctive nasal guard, this helm allows for better airflow, keeping you cool and collected during intense combat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_NorthernFull: When functionality meets comfort you get a soft tunic with closely weaved chainmail vest on top.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_NorthernHalf: Woven from wool, with an added layer of chain mail protection, maintaining a comfortable and breathable feel.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianArca: A hood woven from the finest silk infused with obsidian powder. Dark violet like a piece of the night itself, the soft fabric conceals an unexpected resilience.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianBard: A massive bardiche with a deep purple hue. Its obsidian-forged blade resists dulling, maintaining consistent striking power.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianBloo: Sturdy leather gloves dyed with beast blood and obsidian powder, bearing a deep violet hue and a calm, subtle sheen.
A robe finished with thread dyed in beast blood and obsidian powder. The deep violet that envelops the body lends it an air of dark luxury.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianCham: Smelted from obsidian ore, this armor boasts exceptional durability and holds firm against the harshest of blows.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianChap: A wide-brimmed helmet forged from obsidian ore. Its refined violet surface is smooth yet unyielding.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianCloa: Infused with obsidian powder, this cloak bears a deep violet hue, its rich sheen revealed with grace when caught in the light.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianClot: Trousers made from plain cloth infused with obsidian powder. Light and comfortable, though offering little protection against impact.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianCutl: An obsidian-forged cutlass. Its deep violet blade is finely honed, easily severing enemy flesh.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianDark: A plate armor forged from obsidian ore, smelted into thin panels and fitted together. Exceptionally sturdy, its polished surface carries the subtle sheen unique to obsidian.
Boots refined to a craftsman's standard and enhanced with obsidian powder. Flexible in fit, yet dependably durable.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianHeav: Gauntlets forged from thin obsidian steel plates. Smooth and unyielding, they offer steady protection for the hands.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianIngo: A highly enriched ingot of pure obsidian.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianLeat: Basic leather gloves dyed with obsidian powder. Thick and sturdy, with a smooth, even surface.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianMorn: A morningstar forged from obsidian ore. While maintaining its heavy form, the tips of its spikes are honed sharper to concentrate its impact.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianNort: A soft tunic layered with chainmail of woven obsidian ore. It fits naturally against the body, offering comfort without sacrificing protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianOnyx: Leather gloves tinted deep violet with obsidian powder. They wrap naturally around the hands, feeling almost as though nothing is worn at all.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianOres: A dirty chunk of rock bearing traces of glassy dark-violet obsidian.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianPadd: Leggings crafted with obsidian powder. They can withstand light blows, but won't hold up for long.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianPlat: Boots forged from smelted obsidian. Their surfaces gleam like glass, yet offer exceptional protection for the feet.
This obsidian plate leg armor shimmers with a subtle violet glow, its smooth exterior belying a formidable defense.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianPowd: Powder made by finely grinding obsidian ore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianShad: A mask crafted from cloth woven with obsidian powder. The deep violet fabric veils the face, lending an air of dark mystery.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ObsidianStef: A decorative hat finely embroidered with obsidian powder-infused thread. Delicate violet stitching and feather trim lend it a refined charm.

DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SulfurSaliva: It is a sticky saliva that gives off a strong sulfurous odor. Highly flammable, it can easily catch fire and should be handled with care.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SunburstOrb_: Originally crafted to aid the Light Bringers in their sacred mission, this orb exposes those who slither in the shadows, preventing them from finding sanctuary in darkness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SurgicalKit_: A medical kit used to dress serious wounds.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SurvivalBow_: This fast and lightweight wooden bow was improvised by adventurers for survival.
A bow made by the elves by forging the branches of the tree of truth.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TailOfCentau: A wicked extension from a centaur demon that is treasured.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Tanglethread: Crafted by a renowned tailor, commissioned by beings of both shadow and light, these trousers rank among his most coveted creations. Highly prized by collectors and adventurers alike, they feature a unique thread pattern—his signature, marking the work of a tailor with unparalleled skill.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Tar: A thick, black, sticky liquid. A staple for sailors, it is used to waterproof and repair ships. Highly flammable, it must be handled with care.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TatteredChok: A crude choker made by tying together scraps of leather and worn bandages. There is no sign of proper tailoring, and its shape is rough and awkward. It barely deserves to be called a choker, yet it holds a faint but undeniable magical presence.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TatteredCloa: A cloak worn out after many adventures, but familiar to the body.
A cloak worn out after many adventures, but familiar to the body.
A cloak worn out after many adventures, but familiar to the body.
